scope:
Extract fixed Pathfinder preflight/cache evidence from five pinned NetLogs.

Only exact api-partner Pathfinder OPTIONS decoded fields, public CORS response
fields, header names, protocol/source joins and relative times leave this tool.
Original CORS input-header values are never copied or printed. No Dart, app,
profile, account or network operation is performed.

sourceJoinContract: Exact fixed CORS_REQUEST URL source -> CORS_PREFLIGHT_URL_REQUEST source_dependency -> OPTIONS transaction send and response on that request source. H2 additionally joins request -> HTTP_STREAM_REQUEST_BOUND_TO_JOB -> HTTP2_SESSION_SEND_HEADERS source_dependency. H3 joins request -> HTTP_STREAM_REQUEST_BOUND_TO_QUIC_SESSION and exact quic_stream_id.
independentCacheObservations: CHECK_CORS_PREFLIGHT_CACHE miss is followed on each linked source by a separate original OPTIONS request and CORS_PREFLIGHT_RESULT.
CHECK_CORS_PREFLIGHT_CACHE hit-and-pass plus CORS_PREFLIGHT_CACHED_RESULT proves an accepted cached permission result; absence of OPTIONS alone is not used as cache-hit proof.
Multiple same-profile cache misses can be associated before any prior same-route preflight response is observed; each retained miss has its own outgoing OPTIONS.
The response advertises Access-Control-Max-Age 604800; these captures do not measure actual expiry, Chromium caps, persistence or cross-partition sharing.
limits: Decoded HTTP field names, values and sequence only; no HPACK/QPACK/TLS/QUIC byte fingerprint or packet-order parity.

Only exact fixed Pathfinder URL and public OPTIONS/CORS fields are exported. Original CORS input values, credentials, account/device/content identifiers, arbitrary targets and private command lines are omitted.
Response Content-Length 0 is a declared response-body length, not evidence about request-body length.
H2 fin=true explicitly proves request closure at HEADERS. H3 FIN/no-DATA metadata is retained separately from byte-exact empty-body proof.
CORS cache statuses/results are direct original events. Public response chronology does not expose the complete internal partition, credentials-mode, cache-key or entry identity.
A parent CORS_REQUEST can have no outgoing POST send event in the retained log; no logical send, cancellation or body outcome is invented for those rows.
Initial misses do not prove globally empty startup state; cache hits do not establish how far before capture another entry might have been learned.
Forced-H2 diagnostic is separate from captures lacking QUIC force/disable flags; lack of those flags is not proof of factory-default/persisted protocol state.
No original app/profile/process, network action, Dart/runtime change, test execution or Chromium decompilation.
